scope:
Independent U10 daily/subgroup review against U9a and the original release.

Retain event extremes and source attribution limits instead of accepting an
aggregate sediment total as evidence of correct daily routing.

trapezoid_publication_check_days2on.note: Only discharge-publication consistency; not a physical water budget.

q0_peak_diagnostic.note: Printed positive-time max can omit q0; both printed quantities have rounding. First q0 unknown.

definitions.sampled_volume: 600 times sum of printed positive-time discharge samples; right-endpoint quadrature, matching prior Cedar comparison
definitions.reported_volume: chanwb Outflow, checked against EBE; same publication definitions in both releases; verify against sampled routing separately
definitions.trapezoid: Daily q0 reconstructed from previous endpoint; first day unknown; printed precision prevents exact solver closure
definitions.event_selection: Union of reference and candidate daily peaks (prominence0.1m3/s, spacing7days) and ten largest daily peak changes; plus/minus3day overlapping descriptive windows, not independent storms
definitions.source: Frozen Cedar 10cm RRINIT, 1980–2003,864 hills,371 channels; MC4 at600seconds
